segments.text: . It is indeed magnificently bound & I am not surprised that you did not like to send it per post, & am only surprised that you would send it anyhow.— I was headachy & half-knocked up during all my stay & I found it impossible to look it over whilst in

so have brought it with me, & shall consult it deliberately for I have found more variability in Birds nests than I expected after I had put my notes together. I presume you are in no hurry, & so will leave it at Mr.
.— Very many thanks for the loan.—
In your last note, what a funny fact that it of
the frog: I think it will do to work in: I wish I knew about how old they were, but probably you will not recollect. How fine it would have been if they had squatted at the sight of the monster.—
You say that if you can anyhow manage it, you will this
pay us a visit; it would really give
myself great pleasure; so do not forget & come if you can. I am not likely to be from home,
, without it be sometimes for a fortnight to
Farewell my dear old friend. If the spirit moves you at anytime to send me a line about yourself, glad shall I be. Ever yours |
